name: 上吊线形态
description: Hanging Man Pattern - 上升趋势中的看跌反转形态

computation_data.function_code:
def calculate(data, **kwargs):
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    close_col = 'close' if 'close' in data.columns else 'S_DQ_CLOSE'
    high_col = 'high' if 'high' in data.columns else 'S_DQ_HIGH'
    low_col = 'low' if 'low' in data.columns else 'S_DQ_LOW'
    open_col = 'open' if 'open' in data.columns else 'S_DQ_OPEN'
    
    close = data[close_col]
    high = data[high_col]
    low = data[low_col]
    open_ = data[open_col]
    
    body = np.abs(close - open_)
    upper_shadow = high - np.maximum(close, open_)
    lower_shadow = np.minimum(close, open_) - low
    
    result = ((lower_shadow > 2 * body) & (upper_shadow < body) & (body > 0)).astype(float)
    return result
